title: Nyx SMP
description: A massive Unstable-style SMP featuring amplified terrain, dynamic factions, the Farlands, and hostile custom environments. Join today!
body:
🌍 Welcome to NYX Unstable SMP 🌍

A brand new upcoming unstable-style SMP inspired by Unstable SMP progression, terrain, and large-scale faction gameplay.

⚔️ Features

* 🌫️ The Mist
* 🌊 The Great Sea
* 🔥 The Underworld
* ⛰️ Amplified terrain
* 🌌 Farlands progression
* 🏰 Unstable-style builds & kingdoms
* ⚔️ Wars, factions, alliances & betrayals

Explore massive terrain, build hidden empires, raid enemies, and survive in a world where nowhere is truly safe.

Join the community and be part of the server from the very beginning.

💬 discord.gg/nyxsmp
